connection_state.Description: State of the endpoint attachment connection to the service attachment.

host.Description: Host that can be used in either HTTP Target Endpoint directly, or as the host in Target Server.

name.Description:
Name of the Endpoint Attachment in the following format:
organizations/{organization}/endpointAttachments/{endpointAttachment}.

org_id.Description:
The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee instance,
in the format 'organizations/{{org_name}}'.
